title: target-archetype emit
$comment: HAND-AUTHORED bespoke data-product contract for the target-archetype AUX skill (companion/classifier; NOT a fan-out decision — does not carry the skill_decision envelope, run_health, or headline.skill_report). This is NOT generated by validators/gen_skill_output_schemas.py and has NO pin. It locks the STABLE top-level identity + the verdict-INERT contract (verdict is null by design) + the classification vocabularies (anchor labels, confidence-caveat reason/tier), and leaves the phenotype-mixture / novelty / scorecard payload OPEN (additionalProperties:true) so those numeric internals can evolve within a contract major version. Self-contained: no cross-file/network $ref. Append-only within contract major version.

anchor_label.description: Canonical archetype anchor labels (atlas.json anchors[].label): the 8 base labels, or '?' (unlabeled). A DATA-DERIVED soft label (assigned to an unlabeled analog by clustering) appends a trailing '~' (e.g. 'tsg_loss~') — archetype_core._analog_label. The optional '~' suffix is part of the contract.

verdict.description: Verdict-INERT by design: this skill informs but never gates a nomination.

companion.description: Phenotype-mixture companion. Numeric internals (soft_membership, missingness, mixture_uncertainty, novelty) are OPEN; the classification vocabulary + verdict-inert caveat are pinned.
